verdict.rationale: Qdrant's security docs describe three API key types: Admin, Read-Only and Granular Access. The granular keys scope read/write permissions per collection, which covers the API-key, role-like tiers and per-collection parts of the story. Evidence is limited to short first-party snippets. Missing for 10: detail on custom role definitions or the permission model beyond the three key tiers, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can enforce granular access control (API keys, roles, per-collection permissions) on database operations

citations.quote: Qdrant supports three types of API key: **Admin API Key**... **Read-Only API Key**... **Granular Access API Keys**
read-only API keys for query-only consumers and granular access API keys with per-collection read/write scoping
